exploit_name: Cross-contract reentrancy in liquidation enables phantom share theft
description: Sequential settlement of collateral trackers combined with an unprotected external ETH refund call creates a reentrancy window where phantom shares (2^248-1) can be transferred before revocation.
attack_scenario: 1) Liquidation triggers, delegating phantom shares to ct1. 2) ct0.settleLiquidation executes and calls safeTransferETH, passing control to attacker. 3) During callback, attacker calls ct1.transferFrom to steal phantom shares. 4) ct1.settleLiquidation inflates _internalSupply to compensate, permanently minting shares.
root_cause: Sequential settlement of collateral trackers combined with an unprotected external ETH refund call creates a reentrancy window where phantom shares (2^248-1) can be transferred before revocation.
fix_description: Implement nonReentrant on settleLiquidation, or defer external calls until all settlements complete. Forbid phantom share transfers via validation in transferFrom.
notes: Complete drainage of assets from CollateralTracker causing catastrophic loss of funds for liquidity providers.
